name: AUM Gam Ganapataye Namaha
meaning: I offer salutations to Ganapati, the lord of the Ganas and remover of obstacles.
purpose: A short devotional invocation used before beginnings and important tasks.
supports: Preparing attention; identifying obstacles; approaching work with patience and clarity.
when: Before study, work, travel or starting something new.
note: The bija syllable Gam is part of a widely used Ganesha formula.
